caption:
Chilli Cheese Fried Eggs
breakfast under 300 calories 

Nutrition: 
C: 3 | F: 17 | P: 18
Calories: 255 without bread
with 2 slices of bread: 440 calories ( i use basic 100% whole wheat) 
Makes 1 portion

Ingredients
1/2 tsp chilli oil
1/2 tsp white sesame seeds
2 eggs
1 green chilli, finely chopped
12 grams cheese, basically 3/4 cheese cube or you can use as much or as little as you like! ive used @kodaicheese ‘s gouda here and it gives great flavour.. a nice sharp cheese works well for this recipe but if you dont have it please go ahead and use regular cheese cubes! 
pinch of black pepper
i dont use salt here as cheese does have salt but if you need it, feel free to add :) 

Ingredients 
add chilli oil to the pan and the sesame seeds, allow it to get hot
add the eggs to the pan 
allow to cook a little but not all the way as you want runny yolks
add the chopped chilli and grated cheese
top with some black pepper
enjoy with bread or as is :) 

pro tip
CHEEESE: ive used @kodaicheese ‘s gouda here and it gives great flavour.. a nice sharp cheese works well for this recipe (adds that umami) but if you dont have it please go ahead and use regular cheese cubes! 

micro grater: i got this from ikea recently and its amazing, helps a little bit of cheese look like alot making it easier to portion control! 

dont have chilli oil? use butter or oil for the pan, this is needed for greasing but tbh if you have a great non stick pan, you wont need any fat :)
